title: Defined division
contract: Division by zero returns a distinct error; other inputs return exact rational quotient.
scope: Numerator and denominator -2..2; exact rational arithmetic.
assumptions: Exact finite abstract model in scope; no inference to unbounded behavior, LLMLang correspondence or other semantic profiles.

obligations.claim: Zero denominator returns error; nonzero denominator returns rational q with q*d=n.

variants.description: Use reduced numerator/denominator with sign normalization.
